2nd Annual Pints and Pages Book Fair at KinderHill Brew Lab

Saturday, November 7, 2026
12:00 PM – 10:00 PM

  • Admission: Free
Website

Do you remember the amazing Book Fairs of your youth? Well, KinderHill is partnering up with Hyperbole Bookstore and Voices For Children to bring back the good times! This is a book fair and vendor market.

They will be donating 10% of all beverage sales from this event to Voices For Children to help continue their work in our community. Come find your new favorite book!
